name: assure
description: Exact-release security, operations, then final quality evidence chain

tasks.prompt: Inventory quality-specific evidence for canonical release tuple only; do not issue final readiness. Require release_id, source_revision, artifact_digest, provenance_id, target_environment_id, configuration_digest, and deployment_version|NOT_DEPLOYED. Return BLOCK or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when tuple/evidence manifest is incomplete. Objective/release tuple: {{objective}}

Assess exact release tuple and reviewed scope. Passive evidence only unless explicit authorization is included. Return scoped security disposition. Canonical subject: {{subject}} Quality precheck: {{dependencies}} Objective: {{objective}}

Assess operational evidence for exact canonical release tuple. Use security disposition, but do not require final quality state. Return OPERATIONS_EVIDENCE_PASS/OPERATIONS_EVIDENCE_FAIL, EXCEPTION_REQUIRED, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Canonical subject: {{subject}} Inputs: {{dependencies}} Objective: {{objective}}

Integrate quality-specific evidence with exact-tuple security and operations results. Verify canonical subject equality and immutable evidence. Return final READY, NOT_READY, EXCEPTION_REQUIRED, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Never emit READY_WITH_ACCEPTED_EXCEPTION because harness cannot authenticate human approval. Canonical subject: {{subject}} Inputs: {{dependencies}} Objective: {{objective}}
